description.value: Jambo Grill Tandoor & Paan House is a family-owned African and Indian fusion restaurant operating since 2005 on Vancouver's busy Kingsway strip, a short walk from Joyce SkyTrain station. The kitchen draws on cooking traditions from Iran, India, East Africa, and Canada, turning out tandoori meats, curries, biryanis, and house-made naan alongside a fully licensed bar in a space that seats up to 100 people. All meats are halal, dishes are made to order, and the restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, and large-scale catering.
